Callback delivery is not complete view, persistence, VFS or process evidence.

remaining: Writer/helper failure and commit/readback semantics, explicit older-saved-state permission, plugin mutation during preparation and supported Windows save/launch workflow.

remaining: Actual override contract, eligible plugin/nonregular backing, mapping installation, existing/new-file writes, stale indices, profile switches, failed/partial backend updates and process output.

remaining: Actual helper and Windows guarantees, identity/races/permissions/cross-volume, links/attributes, interruptions, restart and restoration from real retained data.
